ALPHA RELEASE 0.8

-- The Alpha Release is now live. This version is very experimental but is open to play and give feedback on the discord

-- REMEMBER TO UNZIP THE FILES FIRST BEFORE PUTTING IT INTO THE DATA FOLDER >.>

Overview

This Mod explores the corruption of Valkia the bloody by her cursed shield that contains the soul and mind of a Slaaneshi daemon prince. Locephax.

This mod comprises a scale system that allows the players model to visually change based on their play style culminating in either becoming more Khorne or joining Slaanesh

How do i begin the mod?

[[SPOILER]]

With this mod installed on turn 1 not much will look different. Valkia will still look like her base ingame self. This is so players can decide from when in their campaign the corruption campaign should begin.

To start the process follow the bellow

-
Valkia has to withdraw from a battle encounter (This doesnt mean fight it, this is the prebattle scene where you autoresolve etc)

-
Having withdrawn, you will be greeted with a dilemma of Valkia getting wailed on and earn the 'intrigue of the dark prince' trait

-
After that you will need to wait 3 turns, after 3 turns have passed since the last event, should you withdraw from a battle encounter a second time a second dilemma will fire

-
Valkia will now be in her N0 (stage 1) of the corruption mod form and the player can now earn and lose favour of the two goods (See mechanics sections)

How Progression is Calculated

Main Progression Mechanic

[[SPOILER]]

Main progression is measured in blocks

The player starts at 105 points which is representative of the Base Level

Whenever the player drops below the denomination of 10 they will proc a dilemma and model change

For example, when the player drops below 100 or 90 etc they will drop to that relevant level

This number will eventually be shown visually on screen but you can track this via the log file in your data folder

[img https://imgpile.com/images/TgMs4k.png]

F.A.Q

How i download the mod?

[[SPOILER]]

press the download button

[[/SPOILER]]

How do i install this mod?

[[SPOILER]]

place the pak file in your warhammer 3 data folder and enable it in the games mod maanger

Your data folder is normally found in this file path ;

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III\data

[[/SPOILER]]

I used the cheat sheet to fire a dilemma but my model didnt change?

[[SPOILER]]

Model changes are based on the tracking variable that will fire dilemma's when it detects a block change.

Firing dilemmas via console will only give you text

You would need to change the variable number

[[/SPOILER]]

Where is the Profane Hold?

[[SPOILER]]

Profane Hold is near Kuark, a settlement near the starting location between two mountains
